definitions.ask: Should the 📍 maps badge also lose its location title, with the agenda reading the location from the Maps URL instead?
definitions.why: One title-free rule for every badge; the place stays recoverable from the Maps query

choices.label: All three badges go title-free; Ctrl+L opens a clean Maps search too
Only 📅/📹 go title-free; 📍 keeps its tooltip but Ctrl+L sends a messy Maps query
